metadata.title: OMEGA Unified Country General Data Registry
metadata.description: Canonical common-schema registry aggregating identity, basic facts, economy, demographics, general indexes, resource context, public-safety summary and a source-aware strategic country profile for every identity in countries.json.

externalRefresh.policy: A refreshed observation replaces a legacy value only when the World Bank API returns a numeric observation. When a refresh is unavailable, previously stored World Bank observations are preserved.

dataQualityPolicy.nullMeans: unknown, unavailable, not imported, or not comparable; never zero
dataQualityPolicy.countryScope: all country and territory identities in countries.json, not only UN member states
dataQualityPolicy.mergePolicy: additive aggregation with per-field provenance; original source datasets remain untouched
dataQualityPolicy.crossMetricComparisons: different indicators can have different observation years; check metricMetadata[field].year before combining
dataQualityPolicy.disciplineIndex: left null unless a defined, comparable source or an approved project-specific formula exists
dataQualityPolicy.strategicProfiles: Generated for every canonical identity from existing repository indicators and existing game relation/resource-site inputs; derived tendencies are labelled and are not official country ratings.
dataQualityPolicy.militaryCapability: Do not infer operational military strength from spending share, GDP or population alone.
dataQualityPolicy.resourceSiteSimulation: Gameplay resource-site counts are scenario records; simulated reserves are not treated as observed national reserves.

recordSchema.description: Each group array follows its listed field names in order. Metric positions follow fieldCatalogue. Provenance integer codes decode with metadata.provenanceEncoding. All source observations are retained; null is never zero.
recordSchema.strategicProfileEncoding: ORDERED_VALUE_ARRAY_V1; decode each country strategicProfile array using this ordered list

sourceNames: Derived from same-year World Bank observations

sharedModelNotes.crimeSourcePolicy: Only observedHomicide is marked source-observed in this local baseline. Other crime rates are modeled simulation values unless their source says otherwise.
sharedModelNotes.resourceEmptyLists: An empty array means no entries were recorded in this source record; it does not prove the country has no such resource.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

naturalResources: An empty array means no entries were recorded in this source record; it does not prove the country has no such resource.
